title: Magical Dyes
description: Substances mixed into conjuring ink to modify a drawn spell. Cosmetic or practical; see docs/magical-dye.md.

dyes.name: Azuremoon Flower
dyes.effect: Increases the duration of the drawn magic.

dyes.name: Blood
dyes.effect: Greatly increases the power of the drawn spell.

dyes.name: Golden Blaze Wyrm Scales
dyes.effect: Makes the ink glow in the dark.
